up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL2321810. For each such molecule, retrieve the molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (from molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (from molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Return the results as a list of rows with one row per distinct molecule. If a molecule appears multiple times in the document, only list it once. Include molecules even if some of these attributes are missing (NULL).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2321810';
